title: Decoded #19: RoAS Up 112%. Why That Isn't the Number to Copy
hook: RoAS Up 112%. Why That Isn't the Number to Copy
caption:
Decoded by Galvor, Issue #19: RoAS Up 112%. Why That Isn't the Number to Copy

Three anonymised Galvor results, from fashion, beauty and wellness, each come with a headline RoAS gain. Each also comes with an attention number: hook rate or hold rate. This issue closes proof season by arguing that the second number is the one a brand can brief from, and shows how to read a pilot result so it repeats.

Subscribe to get it every Wednesday.
notes: Outline planned 18 Nov 2026 (why now: Closes February's proof season with the roll-up of all three anonymised results, the same week the page runs its scorecard carousel (Thu 25 Feb) and as brands plan Q1 FY28 budgets in March.).
